INSIDE THINKAIWORK

See how finance workflows become structured, repeatable, and auditable.

THE PROBLEM

Generic AI was not built for finance control.

Finance teams do not just need faster answers. They need repeatable context, consistent outputs, controlled costs, model flexibility, and an audit trail they can defend.

BLANK PROMPT SURFACE

Generic AI starts without finance controls.

01
Generic output

No board voice, no company context, no competitive edge.

02
Context drift

Institutional knowledge gets re-explained every month — then disappears again.

03
No fixed structure

Different analyst, different output. No repeatability, no trust.

04
Exploding token cost

The same context is resent every call, with little visibility into spend.

05
Model lock-in

Prompts, workflows, and outputs become trapped inside one vendor.

06
Cluttered context

Files, teams, entities, and geographies become impossible to govern.

The issue is not intelligence. It is the missing control structure around context, cost, evidence, and repeatability.

Frequently asked questions

Find some quick answers to the most common questions.

What is ThinkAIWork?
+

ThinkAIWork is Selona's AI-agnostic workspace for finance teams and fractional CFOs. It turns controlled inputs into structured, auditable outputs for recurring finance work.

How is it different from generic AI tools?
+

Generic tools start from a blank prompt. ThinkAIWork lets teams define context, versions, reusable skills, output templates, budget limits, and model routing before workflows run.

Which finance workflows does it support first?
+

The private beta is focused on recurring CFO work such as board commentary, variance analysis, VAT/GST reconciliation, stakeholder updates, management accounts, and forecast narratives.

Can we change AI models later?
+

Yes. ThinkAIWork is designed so context, skills, and templates can be reused across Anthropic, OpenAI, and local model deployments without rebuilding the finance workflow from scratch.

What security information is available?
+

Security documentation is available on request. Public pages avoid unconfirmed certification or deployment claims until they are formally documented.
